description: Real case: Portuguese speech, speech languages en/pt/de, two-language translation prompt — output is only the two translations, with no note about the instructions
spokenText: Então, a ideia é ter a opção de ter vários custom prompts. No caso que você queira mudar o tom da conversa, do transcript, você pode mudar. Ou, no caso aqui, eu estou testando com tradução e funcionou a tradução para duas línguas. E também tem um shortcut ali que você pode ciclar entre os prompts e aparece no HUD.
promptInstructions:
Translate the text into English and German. Output only the translation, keeping the original meaning, tone and formatting.

Do NOT add any additional information such as a brief "introduction/header" like
```
The custom instructions say to translate into English and German and output only the translation. So I'll provide both.
```
expectedOutput:
So, the idea is to have the option of having several custom prompts. In case you want to change the tone of the conversation, of the transcript, you can change it. Or, in this case, I'm testing with translation, and the translation worked for two languages. And there's also a shortcut there that lets you cycle between the prompts, and it shows up in the HUD.

Also, die Idee ist, die Möglichkeit zu haben, mehrere benutzerdefinierte Prompts zu verwenden. Falls du den Ton des Gesprächs, des Transkripts, ändern möchtest, kannst du das tun. Oder, in diesem Fall, teste ich gerade mit Übersetzung, und die Übersetzung hat für zwei Sprachen funktioniert. Außerdem gibt es dort einen Shortcut, mit dem du zwischen den Prompts wechseln kannst, und er wird im HUD angezeigt.
